review_locator: PMCID:PMC5241313, STATs in NK-Cells: The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly; PMCID:PMC8042445, IL-10-Producing ILCs: Molecular Mechanisms and Disease Relevance
primary_title: Stat4-dependent, T-bet-independent regulation of IL-10 in NK cells
decision_basis: The reviews identify STAT4 as an IL-12-responsive regulator of IL-10 in NK cells; the cited primary demonstrates IL-12-induced STAT4 binding at a conserved intronic Il10 element, cytokine-associated chromatin acetylation and loss of Il10 induction in Stat4-deficient NK cells.
limitations_preserved: Direct intronic STAT4 binding and Stat4-dependent Il10 transcription support a bounded NK-cell gene-regulation edge; the STAT4 requirement is context-specific, and no universal IL-10 secretion, IL10R signaling, SCI relevance, or terminal-TF output is inferred.
